panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Live MCP sessions right now (gauge; stateful mode only — 0 in stateless mode).

panels.title: Search rate
panels.description: searxng_web_search calls per second.

panels.title: Fetch rate
panels.description: searxng_read_url calls per second.

panels.title: Metadata rate
panels.description: searxng_url_metadata calls per second.

panels.title: Overall error ratio
panels.description: Errors across all three tools divided by all tool calls.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(mcp_search_errors_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(mcp_fetch_errors_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(mcp_metadata_errors_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum(rate(mcp_searches_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(mcp_fetches_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(mcp_metadata_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Fraction of read_url requests served from the in-memory cache.

panels.title: Fetch p99 latency
panels.description: 99th-percentile URL-fetch pipeline latency. Top bucket = 30s client timeout.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections
panels.description: 429s from the per-caller token-bucket limiter, per second.

panels.title: Tool-call rate by tool
panels.description: Calls per second for each of the four tools.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Live session count over time (stateful mode). A steady climb under load may mean sessions aren't being reaped — see MCP_SESSION_MAX_AGE.

panels.title: Error rate by tool
panels.description: Absolute error rate for each tool (calls that returned an error).

panels.title: Error ratio by tool
panels.description: Errors as a fraction of calls, per tool. Denominator clamped to ≥1 to avoid divide-by-zero spikes at low traffic.

panels.title: Search round-trip latency
panels.description: SearXNG search round-trip quantiles + mean.

panels.title: Fetch pipeline latency
panels.description: read_url / url_metadata pipeline (dial→extraction) quantiles + mean. Cache hits land sub-ms in the lowest bucket, so watch the upper quantiles.

panels.title: Search latency distribution
panels.description: Full bucket distribution of search latency over time.

panels.title: Fetch latency distribution
panels.description: Full bucket distribution of fetch latency over time. The +Inf row is timeout-adjacent requests.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / (hits + misses) over the selected range.

panels.title: Cache hits vs misses
panels.description: Cache hits and network misses per second (stacked = total read_url load).

panels.title: Force-refresh rate
panels.description: read_url calls with force_refresh=true, which deliberately bypass the cache.

panels.title: Fetches by content type
panels.description: Which extractor handled fetched responses (html / pdf / office / plain / image).

panels.title: Top domains by fetch rate
panels.description: Busiest destination hosts (success + error). domain="__overflow__" aggregates hosts beyond the 512 tracked.

panels.title: Top domains by error rate
panels.description: Destination hosts producing fetch failures — the per-domain health signal for deciding what to drop from config.

panels.title: Fetches by content type over time
panels.description: Content-type mix over time (stacked).

panels.title: Domain-tracking overflow (total)
panels.description: Cumulative fetches rolled into the __overflow__ bucket once >512 distinct domains are seen. Non-zero means either a legitimately large host set (raise maxTrackedDomains) or misdirected queries.

panels.title: Distinct domains tracked
panels.description: Number of distinct destination hosts currently tracked (cap 512).

panels.title: Source verification ratio
panels.description: session_sources calls per fetch — how often agents verify their URLs before answering.

panels.title: Sources elided
panels.description: session_sources calls vs. those that returned an incomplete list. Persistently non-zero elided = raise MCP_HISTORY_ENTRIES.

panels.title: History evictions
panels.description: Sources dropped to make room vs. whole callers dropped from the 1,000-entry cache. Rising caller evictions against stable caller count can mean Mcp-Session-Id key-cardinality abuse.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections
panels.description: Requests rejected by the per-caller token-bucket limiter. Per-identity detail is in the structured WARN log, not here.

panels.title: Total rejections (range)
panels.description: Total 429s over the selected time range.
